title: square app plates
text: square app plates. I purchased these to put little brownie squares on... but the options are limitless.  They are white plastic... sturdy and the perfect size for a bite.  I have even hand washed a few I used with my grandsons and reused.  I don't they are meant to be... but I like to reuse as much as I can.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Mini Disposable Appetizer Plates - 100 Pack 2.95 In. x 2.95 in. White Plastic Dessert Plates - Elegant Design for Weddings, Birthdays, and Formal Parties - Stackable and Convenient - BPA Free
features: Disposable Mini Plates: This pack includes 100 mini appetizer plates that are perfect for serving desserts, hors d'oeuvres, and other bite-sized foods at your next event.

These plates are made from high-quality white plastic, which gives them a sleek and modern look. The white color allows your food to stand out and take center stage, making them perfect for weddings, birthdays, and other formal events.

Stackable and Convenient: The mini dessert plates are designed to be stackable, which makes them easy to store and transport. This feature is especially helpful if you're serving a large number of guests.

BPA Free: These small dessert plates are BPA-free, which means that they're safe for you and your guests to use. You can enjoy your food without worrying about harmful chemicals leaching into your food.

Dimensions: Each plate measures 2.95 inches x 2.95 inches, which makes them the perfect size for small portions of food. This size is ideal for creating an elegant presentation of your appetizers and desserts.
